prompt:
Create a new KFB claymation ink blob sprite sheet called The Tiny Splats. Original image inputs guide complete footless continuous charcoal-plum splat silhouettes, tiny goo hands, thick sculpted filled eyelids, ivory sclera, distinct red iris and black pupil. The fictional Babys & Kleinkinder are conveyed through relative body proportions, facial attitude and props. All are soft organic ink blobs with simple age-appropriate clothing accents. No actual humans. Six independent full characters in a strict 3-column by 2-row landscape sheet, 1536×1024 PNG with real transparent alpha. Equal substantial scale within this sheet. Keep silhouettes and all props within generous clear alpha gutters and canvas margins. No background scene, shadow disc, frame, text, logo or branding. Smooth softly satin handmade plasticine with sparse larger modeled marks, broad fabric folds, smooth glass and finished plastic. No grit or crust. Teeth behind lips. No inherited reference wings, eyepatches or costumes. Soft mint, dusty peach and butter yellow. Simple cozy bibs, onesies and small accessories.
Row-major cast:
1. Male-read determined teether. small round squashed blob, frowning concentration. Key cue: large smooth sage teething ring held to mouth.
2. Female-read astonished bottle holder. plump upright pear, wide offset eyes and little gasp. Key cue: small smooth milk bottle, wide cap and visible milk line.
3. Male-read proud first wobbler. upright tiny crooked bean, open delighted smile. Key cue: one oversized nesting cup held out, romper wrap.
4. Male-read sleepy blanket clutcher. low broad sleepy blob, drooping lids and closed smile. Key cue: small folded blanket held against one cheek.
5. Female-read serious block stacker. squared soft blob, downcast gaze and pursed lips. Key cue: two chunky rounded toy blocks pressed together.
6. Male-read startled bath toy owner. short curved pear, eyes wide and mouth ajar. Key cue: small smooth yellow rubber duck held in both hands, cozy pastel towel wrap.
All six whole ink blobs are distinct and easy to isolate. Simple readable surreal props and varied expressions.
